title: Original Dexcom Reciver loses connection.
body:
I use the original Dexcom receiver and a Samsung S10 with Android 11. Today I worked a little through the Xdrip versions. I noticed that everything works correctly up to version 210203. However, as soon as I have install newer version from 210204 -> 210521 the Dexcom receiver cannot establish a connection to the transmitter. After I install the Version 210203 at the next Connection Xdrip and original Reciver Shows the new value. 
Firmware of the Dexcom Receiver 5.1.2.026

![Screenshot_20210402-215734_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/80785292/113449597-78a53000-93fe-11eb-8072-0b4ba5db41a9.jpg)

comments.body: I have a Bluetooth issue after the update on April 6th. My phone's Bluetooth shuts down every 5mins readings on xdrip no longer work. Only my Dexcom reader works. Super annoying it was fine before the update on my last sensor and transmitter. I changed the transmitter, paired it, did the warm-up with both devices. The phone with xdrip and Dexcom reader. I have no readings on phone anymore and Dexcom reader works fine. Is anyone else having this issue?

@JayJay265 Would you mind performing an experiment?
Please install a recent xDrip release that disables the receiver.
After confirming that the receiver is not receiving readings, please go to the following:

Settings -> Hardware Data Source

Scroll all the way down to the bottom and tap on "Disable Collection".  Now xDrip will not show readings anymore.  

Does the receiver work now?

To go back, just go back to Hardware Data Source and tap on G5/G6 Transmitter to restore xDrip operation.

@JayJay265 
Are you still experiencing this problem?
If yes, would you please confirm, again, that the cross over from working to not working is 2021.02.03 to 2021.02.04?
Would you also confirm that the problem persists with the latest Nightly, 2021.08.04?

@Navid200 
Yes the problem is still there. Only the version from 2021.02.03 works, all afterwards have the same error, including the latest from 2021.08.04.

@JayJay265 
Something changed, in the xDrip code, from Feb. 3 to Feb. 4 that is causing this considering that the same transmitter works fine with the same receiver with one version and not with the other.
Most changes to the Dexcom collector are done to improve functionality for the majority.
This behavior you are experiencing is not the intended behavior the changes were made for.

I can run experiments hoping to find exactly which part of the new code is the reason, change the xDrip code to keep the expected xDrip functionality but remove this unintended behavior, and submit it for release to the public.

The problem I can anticipate is to convince the developers to approve it.  As soon as I submit this, the question will come up "why is the transmitter battery voltage so low".  I can explain to them everything I have stated in the first paragraph above and say that the battery is irrelevant.  If it works with the same receiver and with one version of xDrip, why shouldn't it work with another version of xDrip.
But, I will not have an answer to the question, "why is the battery voltage so low".

If the submission is never approved to be released, I will not have solved any problems.

Is there any chance you can get your hands on a transmitter with expected battery voltages and resistance?

@Navid200 Yes the Reciver work with 2021.02.03 and stop with 2021.02.04. XDrip work with all Versions.
